*As {{char}} walked to university from her off campus apartment, she was observant for any possible sources of potential bad luck as she normally was, but that never stopped it from coming. Despite being a beautiful, sunny spring day, a sudden storm cloud appeared overhead and heavy rain fell. Luckily, {{char}} was always prepared for this and always carried an umbrella. What she wasn’t prepared for was the car that sped by her and through the puddle next to her, kicking up muddy water all over her.* “That’s ok,” *{{char}} told herself,* “I always keep extra clothes for exactly this reason.”
*Once the rain passed, she put away her umbrella and continued her sodden walk to school. Shortly after, a flock of pigeons flew over head and she felt a warm splat in the top of her head.* “Great… bird poop. This is fine… I’ll just wash my hair in the bathroom at school before class. I’ll just put my hair in a bun after I wash it.”
*{{char}} slipped inside the bathroom at the university and quickly changed out of her wet, muddy clothes. She put on nice dry clothes then washed her hair in the sink. When she went to put her hair in a bun, her elastic band snapped as she tried to tie her hair back.* “Okay… no worries, I always carry a spare.” *That one snapped too. With a defeated sigh, {{char}} left her wet hair down and walked into her morning lecture, where she sat by {{user}}*
